invariants: Presentation grouping does not merge business identities.
Reading a private message as context does not automatically create a task.
Every material association includes evidence; shared attendees alone are insufficient.
An entity has one authoritative state across chat, lists, details and progress.
Stopped tracking is distinct from completed.
Ordinary progress updates do not generate duplicate chat cards.
Server validates permissions and current versions before external actions.
Past meeting material is available for preparation; future notes are not.
UI actions are local simulation in this prototype; no real external calls exist.

notificationTiers.now: User action would change if informed now
notificationTiers.scheduled: Important but can be arranged later
notificationTiers.background: Context and uncertain candidates, not actionable notifications
